_: Candidates for the daily build run (.github/workflows/daily-builds.yml). Ranked each day by scripts/build-queue.ts from the live results of the tests named in siblings (sells: 1 when a job or licence rides on it, 0.5 when that kind of test gets use but has not sold). Add a row to queue a test. trends: Google Trends worldwide interest over the last 12 months for trendsTerm, with "cna practice test" = 100 (read 2026-11-23); adds trends x WEIGHTS.perTrend to the score. Leave it out when the term is ambiguous.
